corpus: Real exports from real genealogy programs, curated by cacack/gedcom-go in testdata/README.md: it names the exporting program and version, says which collection each file came from and under what licence, and redacts submitter contact details before carrying a file. Every location below is pinned to an upstream revision, so a later commit there cannot change what this check reads.
policy: No file here is copied into this repository, however permissive its licence. See docs/adr/0011-fetch-corpora-rather-than-vendoring-them.md.

mhftb8-export.ged.what: The volume case: 105 707 lines of vendor idiom, and the file #190 reproduces on.
mhftb8-export.ged.dominates: VAL001 ×11 617 — RIN under an event — is 93% of the 12 442 findings; unresolved-xref ×622 is #190 at scale.
mhftb8-export.ged.suspected: unresolved-xref ×622 is right about the file but prints a set of several hundred xrefs into each message — #190. The code itself sits outside VAL001…VAL015 — #235.
mhftb8-export.ged.redaction: Ten findings measure the upstream corpus rather than the exporter: the submitter records @U2@…@U8@ lost their NAME line and the payloads of EMAIL, ADDR and ADR1 to contact redaction, so SUBM is reported as missing a required NAME seven times and a value three times.

legacy10-2025-export.ged.what: Dates at volume, over FamilySearch-sourced data.
legacy10-2025-export.ged.dominates: VAL004 ×1 015 — dates — is 75% of the 1 349 findings, then VAL010 ×334.

vendor-familyorigins5.ged.what: Dates again, and a file that resolves as 5.5 rather than 5.5.1.

vendor-customtags-torture.ged.what: Vendor extensions at every structure level, nested up to six deep. No single exporting program.
vendor-customtags-torture.ged.suspected: Records unresolved-xref, a code outside VAL001…VAL015 — #235.

atsign-55.ged.what: At-sign torture: @@ doubling and @#...@ escapes in payloads. Exists to be read, so a lexer warning here is suspect.

xref-case.ged.what: XRef case mismatch (@test@ against @TEST@) and an xref containing a space.
xref-case.ged.suspected: The LEXER warning at line 13 and the VAL001 that follows it are ours: an xref containing a space produces an internal message and a cascading unknown tag. Tracked by #234. The record also uses codes outside VAL001…VAL015 — #235.

age-keywords-551.ged.what: 5.5.1 AGE keyword payloads: CHILD/INFANT/STILLBORN, case variants, < and >. Every one of them is a legitimate 5.5.1 age.

date-dual-years.ged.what: Dual-year dates (1699/00) plain, ABT, FROM/TO and BET/AND.
